method.weights: synthetic: normal times a log-normal mixture (heavy tails), log-normal row and column scales, cast to bf16, then quantized by comfy_kitchen.backends.eager. No checkpoint weight is read.
method.reference: fp64 on CPU: the gradient as stored (cast to fp64) times the dequantized weight decoded in fp64 from the same packed tensors and rotated back with an fp64 Hadamard.
method.kernel: comfy_kitchen.backends.mps int8_linear_grad_input and w4a8_linear_grad_input on MPS, output in the gradient dtype (what autograd uses), plus fp32 output to isolate the final rounding.
method.fp64_rounded_to_dtype: the fp64 reference rounded once to the output dtype: the floor for that dtype.
method.dense_same_dtype_mps: torch matmul on MPS of the same gradient with the dequantized weight held dense in that dtype.
method.gradient: normal, log-normal per-token magnitude, scaled by grad_scale
